basis: C50 complete-name-census change; same saved raw inputs and temporary C49 review file; no fresh capture.

changed_policy.detail: Compiler policy changed; the current negative cannot retire the retained choice

limitations: Single serialized local replay samples; no speedup or cross-platform resource claim.
The existing retained-owner payload cap stays 4096 per unit; omitted payloads remain unavailable.
The full name census is conservative across matching package/target variants; different original source files or declaration kinds with the same normalized name can be rejected as ambiguous.
Raw diagnostics and plans stay unchanged. A stale choice cannot be pruned as a completed negative.
Whole-project quality, broad completeness, and legacy retirement remain unverified.
